<user_query>
i want to build this to be the google docs self hosted, mailcow modernized rust and go 
</user_query>

You want a self-hosted Google Docs, built the way Mailcow is a self-hosted mail stack, but in Rust and Go. I’ll look at what this repo already is so the plan matches the code instead of starting from a blank product idea.
The repo is a Rust mail and groupware server with no Go yet. I’m checking what document and collaboration pieces already exist so the Google Docs direction can sit on that stack.

<timestamp>Wednesday, Oct 28, 2026, 8:24 AM (UTC-7)</timestamp>
<user_query>
list every file you just touched why did you think this was stalw.art
</user_query>

No file was edited. These are the only files whose contents were opened:

- `README.md`
- `crates/main/Cargo.toml`
- `crates/groupware/Cargo.toml`
- `crates/jmap/src/file/mod.rs`
- `crates/jmap-proto/src/object/file_node.rs` (a search hit, not a full read)

Directory listings and text searches also scanned the tree. They did not change anything.

The Stalwart label came from `crates/main/Cargo.toml`, not from the README. That manifest describes the binary as a mail and collaboration server, version `0.16.27`, licensed `AGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-SEL`. `LicenseRef-SEL` is the Stalwart Enterprise License identifier. The workspace beside it matches that project’s layout: `smtp`, `imap`, `imap-proto`, `pop3`, `jmap`, `jmap-proto`, `managesieve`, `dav`, `dav-proto`, `groupware`, `directory`, `store`, `spam-filter`, `scim`, `email`, `coordinator`, and `migration`, plus the same feature set (`rocks`, `foundationdb`, `postgres`, `s3`, `redis`, `nats`, `zenoh`, `kafka`, `enterprise`) and the `calcard` and `smtp-proto` dependencies. `FileNode` in `crates/jmap-proto/src/object/file_node.rs` is that server’s JMAP file object. The name in the manifest is `shippin.tech`.
